d:
Watch the thrilling condensed match as England and Wales clashed in the quarter-finals of the 2003 Rugby World Cup. Wales did their best to upset the high-flying English with a three blistering tries, but the soon-to-be World Player of the Year, Jonny Wilkinson, put on a kicking masterclass to guide England to the semi-finals.
